Option Explicit

Private Function Shown(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    If IsError(v) Then
        Shown = CStr(v)
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Shown = "array"
    Else
        Shown = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Public Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim w2 As Object, ws As Object, other As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set w2 = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = w2.Worksheets(1)
    Set other = w2.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws)
    other.Name = "Other"
    ws.Activate
    w2.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Run which, w2, ws, other, r
    s = "ok " & Shown(r)
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Tried = s
    w2.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Answered
End Function

Private Sub Run(ByVal which As Long, w2 As Object, ws As Object, other As Object, r As Variant)
    Dim x As Object, i As Long, n As String
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges)
    Case 1
        r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 2
        r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 3
        r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges("x").Title
    Case 4
        r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Item(0).Title
    Case 5
        For Each x In ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges: i = i + 1: Next: r = i
    Case 6
        r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Parent)
    Case 7
        r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Application)
    Case 8
        r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add("One", ws.Range("A1")))
    Case 9
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 10
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 11
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges("One").Title
    Case 12
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges("ONE").Title
    Case 13
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Item(1).Title
    Case 14
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1)
    Case 15
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1))
    Case 16
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 17
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Parent.Name
    Case 18
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users)
    Case 19
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Count
    Case 20
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Parent)
    Case 21
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = TypeName(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Application)
    Case 22
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): For Each x In ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges: r = TypeName(x): Next
    Case 23
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2")
    Case 24
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "ONE", ws.Range("C1"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 25
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "", ws.Range("A1")
    Case 26
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One"
    Case 27
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add
    Case 28
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", "A1"
    Case 29
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", Nothing
    Case 30
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add 5, ws.Range("A1"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 31
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add String(255, "a"), ws.Range("A1"): r = Len(ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title)
    Case 32
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add String(256, "a"), ws.Range("A1")
    Case 33
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "A B", ws.Range("A1"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 34
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "1a", ws.Range("A1"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 35
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1,C3"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 36
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), "pw": r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 37
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", other.Range("A1")
    Case 38
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A:A"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 39
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "Two", ws.Range("A1"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 40
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title = "New": r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 41
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "Two", ws.Range("C1"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title = "Two"
    Case 42
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title = ""
    Case 43
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range = ws.Range("D4"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 44
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): Set ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range = ws.Range("D4"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 45
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range = "D4"
    Case 46
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).ChangePassword "pw": r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 47
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).ChangePassword
    Case 48
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Unprotect
    Case 49
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), "pw": ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Unprotect "pw": r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 50
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), "pw": ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Unprotect "no"
    Case 51
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Delete: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 52
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Delete
    Case 53
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "Two", ws.Range("C1"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Delete: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 54
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): Set x = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1): x.Delete: r = x.Title
    Case 55
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Add "Everyone", True: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Count & "/" & ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users(1).Name & "/" & ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users(1).AllowEdit
    Case 56
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Add "Nobody Here", True
    Case 57
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Add "Everyone", False: ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.RemoveAll: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Count
    Case 58
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: r = ws.Range("A1").Value
    Case 59
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Range("C1").Value = 1
    Case 60
        ws.Protect: ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2")
    Case 61
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 62
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Delete
    Case 63
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title = "New"
    Case 64
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title
    Case 65
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Unprotect: ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Delete: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 66
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), "pw": ws.Protect: ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
    Case 67
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), "pw": ws.Protect: ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Unprotect "pw": ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: r = ws.Range("A1").Value
    Case 68
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: r = ws.Range("A1").Locked
    Case 69
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Range("A1").Clear
    Case 70
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = 1
    Case 71
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Range("A1:B2").Value = 1: r = ws.Range("B2").Value
    Case 72
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: ws.Range("A1").Interior.ColorIndex = 3
    Case 73
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Rows(1).Insert: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 74
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Columns(1).Delete: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 75
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"): ws.Columns(1).Delete: r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count
    Case 76
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Range("A1:B2").Cut ws.Range("D5"): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address
    Case 77
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Copy After:=ws: r = ActiveSheet.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count & "/" & ActiveSheet.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title & "/" & ActiveSheet.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Parent.Name
    Case 78
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): w2.Save
    Case 79
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "Two", ws.Range("C1,E5"): w2.Save
    Case 80
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1"), "pw": w2.Save
    Case 81
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protect: w2.Save
    Case 82
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Users.Add "Everyone", True: w2.Save
    Case 83
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Delete: w2.Save
    Case 84
        ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "One", ws.Range("A1:B2"): ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "Two", ws.Range("C1"), "pw": w2.Save: n = w2.FullName: w2.Close False: Set w2 = Workbooks.Open(n): Set ws = w2.Worksheets(1): r = ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Count & "/" & ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title & "/" & ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Range.Address & "/" & ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(2).Title & "/" & ws.Protection.AllowEditRanges(2).Range.Address
    End Select
End Sub
